_comment: Projects for projects.html. Each entry: title, start and end (YYYY or YYYY-MM; leave end empty for ongoing), description (2-3 sentences), methods (list of technologies or methods), links (list of {label, url}; use labels like code, paper, demo). Links left as [[...]] placeholders or empty are hidden.

projects.title: Multi-Hypothesis Visual Abductive Reasoning: An Agentic Approach
projects.description: A probabilistic visual-reasoning framework that uses graph-derived ambiguity blocks to factorize spatial uncertainty and support multi-hypothesis interpretation of complex scientific images. An agentic pipeline ties together SAM-family segmentation, adaptive prompting, uncertainty propagation and downstream quantitative analysis across imaging conditions.

projects.title: Mapping the Prompt-Response Landscape of Foundation Segmentation Models
projects.description: A framework for mapping prompt-response basins: sampling strategies that identify the distinct segmentation outputs a model can produce and estimate their probability mass under a limited inference budget.

projects.title: Vision-Based Robotic Pick Selection for Agriculture Automation
projects.description: Visual perception modules for agricultural robots, built on foundation segmentation and detection models over RGB-D and robot data, with visual embeddings and human-in-the-loop learning feeding the robot's pick decisions.

projects.title: Quantifying Semantic Diversity of Visual Reasoning Tasks in LLMs
projects.description: A large-scale comparison of human and LLM reasoning on ARC-style visual tasks. A new similarity metric shows roughly 2× lower semantic diversity in LLaMA-family models, and a statistical and manifold analysis framework compares solution trajectories across tasks.

projects.title: SMART-AFM: Semi-Automated Morphology Analysis of Cellulose Nanocrystals
projects.description: An open-source pipeline for atomic force microscopy image analysis that sped up analysis about 40× with about 5% error, reduced measurement variability between labs and improved reproducibility. It covers segmentation, feature extraction, image-quality assessment, artifact-aware preprocessing, uncertainty-aware validation and batch processing.
